hero.title: Civil Engineering (PG) in Mauritius for Indian Students
paras: A Master’s in Civil Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for students interested in structural design, construction, geotechnical engineering, transportation systems, water resources and infrastructure development. It helps graduates deepen their technical knowledge and prepare for specialised engineering, project management and research roles. For Indian students exploring a **Master’s in Civil Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students**, this programme offers a dedicated postgraduate option to consider.

overview: Good news for prospective students: Unlike some other engineering specialisations, Mauritius has a verified dedicated programme: the Master in Civil Engineering with specialisation in Structures and Public Works at the Université des Mascareignes. It is available to local and international students on a part-time basis.

items.q: Can Indian students apply for Civil Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Yes, Indian students meeting the academic criteria and English proficiency requirements can apply to recognized Mauritian institutions.

items.q: What is the medium of instruction for Civil Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Programmes at major Mauritian universities are delivered in English, with bilingual options available at select institutions.

items.q: What are the typical tuition fees for Civil Engineering (PG) in Mauritius?
items.a: Tuition fees generally range between MUR 150,000 and MUR 350,000 per year, offering cost-effective international degree options.

items.q: Is a student visa required for Indian students?
items.a: Yes, international students require an entry permit and student visa issued by the Passport and Immigration Office of Mauritius upon receiving admission.
